title: Greetings
info: These quizzes use simple Bangla. The word in Bangla letters is followed by a way to say it in English letters.
Assalamu alaikum and nomoskar are both polite hellos in Bangladesh. Shubho shokal means good morning.
Dhonnobad means thank you. Doya kore means please.

questions.q: Which is a polite hello in Bangla?
How do you say thank you?

questions.explain: You use it when you ask for something politely.
Bhalo achi means I am well.
